description: Read one organization connector: its kind, transport, catalog entry, credential state (none, pending, active, needs reauthorization, or revoked), and the websites, apps, and agents that hold it. Use it when a connector's calls fail, or before destroying one. It never returns a credential, a header or environment value, or a URL path: only the names of the headers and variables the connector sets. Requires connecting a Valet account.

connector.description: The connector's name in the organization.

org_name.description: The Valet organization the connector belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: get_connector

auth_reason.description: The provider's diagnostic for a revoked or needs_reauth credential. Absent otherwise.

auth_status.description: State of the connector's credential: none, pending, active, needs_reauth, or revoked.

authorized_at.description: When the stored OAuth credential was last written, as an RFC 3339 UTC time: first authorization, reauthorization, or token refresh. Absent when the connector holds no OAuth token.

catalog_ref.description: Name of the catalog entry the connector came from. Absent for a custom connector.

command.description: The executable of a command connector, without its arguments. Absent for an MCP server.

credential_mode.description: How the credential is held: static (a pasted API key), oauth, composio, or wallet. Absent for a connector with no credential record.

env_names.description: Names of the environment variables the connector sets, sorted. Names only, never values.

header_names.description: Names of the HTTP headers the connector sets, sorted. Names only, never values.

holders.description: The websites, apps, and agents that hold the connector. Empty when nothing does; detach each before destroy_connector.

kind.description: Kind of the holder: site, app, or agent.

host.description: Scheme and host of an HTTP connector's URL, such as https://example.com. The path and query are never returned. Absent for a command connector.

kind.description: The connector's type: mcp-server or command.

name.description: Name of the connector in the organization.

needs_reauth.description: True when a person has to authorize the connector again; call reauthorize_connector.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

secrets.description: Names of the secret slots the connector reads. Names only, never values.

status.description: The connector's lifecycle state: active, or pending while it awaits authorization.

transport.description: How the connector's server is reached, such as streamable-http, sse, or stdio. Absent for a command connector.

title: Read a connector
